remind.description: Send a new password to the given email address. The password is generated anew and the previous one stops working. The request is protected by a form check token.

params.em: Email address given in the profile

api_token.description: Issue tokens to an external client by login and password. Returns access_token (a JWT valid for an hour), refresh_token (30 days) and expires_in. Attempts are rate limited.

api_refresh_token.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT without sending the password. The previous refresh token is revoked.

params.refresh_token: A valid refresh token obtained earlier
